name: Notes and tasks help
description: Help mode entries for the Notes and tasks plugin (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Notes
entries.text: Your notes, to-dos and tasks in lists. The console and AmberX show the same ones: change one here and it shows there within seconds.

entries.title: Tasks
entries.text: Your to-dos and tasks by when they're due: Today, Upcoming, Todo, All and Done.

entries.title: Calendar
entries.text: Your events, weekly schedules and tasks with due dates, on the console and AmberX. Drag to make, move or resize. Long-press to drag on a phone, swipe to change the date.

entries.title: Event
entries.text: When, where, repeats and reminders. Guests has the invite list: who replied and what they said, and the buttons that email them.

entries.title: Schedule block
entries.text: One block of a weekly schedule: its day, time and colour.

entries.title: Calendar settings
entries.text: Name and colour. Name a Google calendar for two-way sync through axHub.

entries.title: Layouts
entries.text: Set the calendar window's panes, or save the panes you have under a name. Saved layouts follow you to every device.
